entries.en: Akai found a shaded bench where we could finish our sandwiches.
entries.zh: 阿凯找到一张有树荫的长凳，好让我们坐下吃完三明治。

entries.en: Akaike counted the tickets again after two more guests arrived.
entries.zh: 又来了两位客人后，赤池重新数了一遍票。

entries.en: Akaki offered to mind the stall while I fetched some change.
entries.zh: 阿卡基提出替我看摊，好让我去取些零钱。

entries.en: Our meeting with Akamai ended before the last bus left.
entries.zh: 我们与阿卡迈公司的会议在末班公交车开走前结束了。

entries.en: Our train reached Akashi just as the rain stopped.
entries.zh: 我们的火车到达明石时，雨刚好停了。

entries.en: Akatsuki kept the theatre programmes in a box beneath the bed.
entries.zh: 晓把剧场节目单保存在床下的一个盒子里。

entries.en: Akayev carried the fragile model with both hands through the crowded hall.
entries.zh: 阿卡耶夫双手托着那个易碎的模型，穿过拥挤的大厅。

entries.en: Akbari offered to lend his spare bicycle to a neighbour whose car had broken down.
entries.zh: 一位邻居的汽车坏了，阿克巴里提出把备用自行车借给那位邻居。

entries.en: Akber could hear the music from the flat above even with the windows shut.
entries.zh: 即使关着窗，阿克别尔也能听到楼上公寓的音乐。

entries.en: Akdeniz tucked the loose cable behind the bookcase before the guests arrived.
entries.zh: 客人们到来之前，阿克代尼兹把那根松散的电线塞到了书柜后面。

entries.en: Our akela postponed the woodland walk when the thunderstorm began.
entries.zh: 雷雨开始后，我们的幼童军领队推迟了林间步行活动。

entries.en: Akeley chose the slower route so we could stop beside the lake.
entries.zh: 埃克利选了那条较慢的路线，好让我们能在湖边停留。

entries.en: Aken noticed that one of the picture hooks had come loose.
entries.zh: 阿肯注意到有一个挂画钩松了。

entries.en: Akerlund returned the borrowed sewing machine with a new spool of thread.
entries.zh: 阿克尔隆德归还借来的缝纫机时，附上了一卷新线。

entries.en: Akerson rescued the fallen papers before the wind scattered them across the street.
entries.zh: 埃克森在风把落下的纸张吹得满街都是之前，把它们捡了起来。

entries.en: Akhavan asked us not to move the wet painting until morning.
entries.zh: 阿哈万让我们等到早上再移动那幅未干的画。

entries.en: Akhil spent the train journey trying to untangle his headphones.
entries.zh: 阿希尔在火车上一路都在尝试解开缠在一起的耳机线。

entries.en: Akhtar divided the remaining biscuits equally among the children.
entries.zh: 阿赫塔尔把剩下的饼干平均分给了孩子们。

entries.en: Akhter picked a table from which we could watch the boats.
entries.zh: 阿赫塔尔选了一张可以看船的桌子。

entries.en: Akil checked the weather before deciding whether to bring the picnic indoors.
entries.zh: 艾其尔先看了天气，再决定是否把野餐改到室内。

entries.en: Akila found a torn corner on the map we had just bought.
entries.zh: 阿基拉发现我们刚买的地图有一个角撕破了。

entries.en: Akili borrowed a saucepan large enough for the whole family's soup.
entries.zh: 阿基利借了一口能装下全家人喝的汤的大锅。

entries.en: Akim stopped to photograph the shadows on the empty staircase.
entries.zh: 阿基姆停下来，拍摄空楼梯上的影子。

entries.en: Akina discovered a second pocket hidden inside the lining of the coat.
entries.zh: 秋名发现外套衬里还有一个隐藏的口袋。

entries.en: Akins carried the birthday candles separately to keep them from snapping.
entries.zh: 埃金斯把生日蜡烛分开拿着，免得折断。

entries.en: The parcel was still in Akita when I checked the tracking page.
entries.zh: 我查看物流页面时，包裹还在秋田市。

entries.en: Akito offered to collect the costumes before the rehearsal.
entries.zh: 明人主动提出在排练前去取戏服。

entries.en: Akiva wrote down the address because his phone battery was almost empty.
entries.zh: 阿基瓦记下了地址，因为他的手机快没电了。

entries.en: Akka drew the curtains to keep the afternoon sun off the screen.
entries.zh: 阿卡拉上窗帘，免得午后的阳光照到屏幕上。

entries.en: I left my scarf at a cafe in Akko.
entries.zh: 我把围巾忘在了阿卡的一家咖啡馆里。

entries.en: Akol remembered to bring a torch but forgot the spare batteries.
entries.zh: 阿科尔记得带手电筒，却忘了带备用电池。

entries.en: Akoto slipped a clean cloth beneath the wet vase to protect the table.
entries.zh: 阿科托把一块干净的布垫在湿花瓶下面，保护桌面。

entries.en: Aksel volunteered to look after the plants during our holiday.
entries.zh: 阿克塞尔主动提出在我们度假期间照料那些植物。

entries.en: Akshay read the last page twice before closing the novel.
entries.zh: 阿克沙伊把最后一页读了两遍，才合上小说。

entries.en: Aktar put the wet washing in a basket when the clothesline broke.
entries.zh: 晾衣绳断了以后，阿克塔尔把湿衣服装进了篮子。

entries.en: She unpacked her books on the evening she arrived in Aktau.
entries.zh: 到达阿克套的那天晚上，她把书从行李中取了出来。

entries.en: Alaa kept the empty jam jars for the school craft project.
entries.zh: 阿拉把空果酱罐留给了学校的手工项目。

entries.meaningZh: 阿拉巴马州人〔Alabamian 的异体〕
entries.en: An Alabaman in our hiking group lent me a spare pair of socks.
entries.zh: 我们徒步小组里的一位阿拉巴马州人借给我一双备用袜子。

entries.en: At the restaurant, Alacoque asked to move to a corner table with better light.
entries.zh: 阿拉科克在餐厅要求换到角落里一张光线更好的餐桌。

entries.en: Aladin mended the loose strap on his bag before we set off.
entries.zh: 出发前，阿拉丁修好了包上松脱的背带。

entries.en: Alaine folded the map along its original creases before returning it.
entries.zh: 阿莱纳沿原有折痕把地图折好，才还了回去。

entries.en: Alaire recognised the handwriting on the unsigned postcard.
entries.zh: 阿莱尔认出了那张未署名明信片上的笔迹。

entries.meaningZh: 林荫散步道〔西班牙语借词〕
entries.en: We followed the alameda until the shade gave way to an open square.
entries.zh: 我们沿着林荫散步道走，直到树荫到了尽头，眼前出现一个开阔的广场。

entries.meaningZh: 林荫散步道〔西班牙语借词，复数〕
entries.en: The town's alamedas were quieter than its crowded shopping streets.
entries.zh: 这个镇的林荫散步道比拥挤的商业街安静。

entries.en: Alami saved the window seat for a friend carrying a sketchbook.
entries.zh: 阿拉米把靠窗的座位留给了一位带着速写本的朋友。

entries.en: Alamy put his gardening gloves in the basket beside the back door.
entries.zh: 阿拉米把自己的园艺手套放进了后门旁的篮子里。

entries.en: Alana waited for the paint to dry before hanging the shelf.
entries.zh: 阿兰娜等油漆干了以后，才把架子挂上去。

entries.en: Alando checked that the gate was shut before letting the dog outside.
entries.zh: 阿兰多先检查大门是否关好，才把狗放出去。

entries.en: Alane set the broken cup aside so nobody would use it.
entries.zh: 阿兰把破杯子放到一旁，免得有人使用。

entries.meaningZh: 阿兰尼人〔古代族群，复数〕
entries.en: Several Alani accompanied the merchant's caravan in the historical novel.
entries.zh: 在那部历史小说中，几名阿兰尼人与商人的商队同行。

entries.en: Alanna offered to paint the scenery if someone else could build the frames.
entries.zh: 阿兰娜提出，如果有人能搭好框架，她可以负责画布景。

entries.en: Alaoui stood behind the camera while we arranged the chairs for the group photograph.
entries.zh: 我们为集体照摆椅子时，阿拉维站在相机后面。

entries.en: Alarcon found the recipe tucked inside an old library book.
entries.zh: 阿拉孔发现那张食谱夹在一本旧的图书馆藏书里。

entries.en: The geologist lifted a heavy block of alaskite into the vehicle with my help.
entries.zh: 那位地质学家在我的帮助下，把一块沉重的白花岗岩搬进了车里。

entries.en: Alayna opened the parcel carefully to preserve the patterned wrapping paper.
entries.zh: 阿莱娜小心地打开包裹，保留了有花纹的包装纸。

entries.en: Albanese suggested moving the rehearsal to a room with fewer echoes.
entries.zh: 阿尔巴内塞建议把排练改到一间回声少一些的房间。

entries.en: Albani found a place for the spare chair beside the fireplace.
entries.zh: 阿尔瓦尼在壁炉旁找到了一个能放备用椅子的地方。

entries.meaningZh: 阿尔巴雷洛罐〔意大利借词，陶瓷罐〕
entries.en: A small crack in the albarello made the collector reconsider the purchase.
entries.zh: 阿尔巴雷洛罐上的一道小裂缝，让那位收藏者重新考虑是否购买。

entries.en: The conservator found traces of albarium beneath the later wall paintings.
entries.zh: 修复师在后来的壁画下面发现了灰泥的残迹。

entries.en: The repairer set aside the bent albata spoon rather than polish it.
entries.zh: 修理匠没有抛光那把弯曲的德国银勺子，而是把它搁在一旁。

entries.en: Albe carried a spare jumper in case the evening turned cold.
entries.zh: 阿尔贝带了一件备用套头衫，以防晚上变冷。

entries.en: The albedometer was mounted above an undisturbed patch of snow.
entries.zh: 反照率测量仪安装在一块未受扰动的雪面上方。

entries.en: Albee took the flowers out of their wrapping before finding a vase.
entries.zh: 艾碧先拆掉鲜花的包装，再去找花瓶。

entries.en: Alberdi asked us to keep the doorway clear for the delivery.
entries.zh: 阿尔韦迪让我们把门口留空，方便送货。

entries.meaningZh: 旅店；小旅馆〔意大利语借词〕
entries.en: Our room at the albergo overlooked a courtyard full of bicycles.
entries.zh: 我们在那家旅店的房间俯瞰着一个停满自行车的庭院。

entries.meaningZh: 公路旁小旅馆〔西班牙语借词〕
entries.en: We reached the roadside albergue with muddy boots and no reservation.
entries.zh: 我们到那家路边小旅馆时，靴子上满是泥，也没有事先预订。

entries.en: Albero knew which cupboard held the spare light bulbs.
entries.zh: 阿尔贝罗知道备用灯泡放在哪个橱柜里。

entries.en: Alberti lent us a larger suitcase for the costumes.
entries.zh: 阿尔贝蒂借给我们一个更大的行李箱，用来装戏服。

entries.en: Albertina found a quiet staircase where she could make a phone call.
entries.zh: 阿尔贝蒂娜找到一处安静的楼梯，好打个电话。

entries.en: Albertine added a second blanket to the bed before the guests arrived.
entries.zh: 客人们到来之前，艾伯丁在床上又加了一条毯子。

entries.en: Albertini checked every pocket before admitting that the key was missing.
entries.zh: 阿尔贝蒂尼检查了每一个口袋，才承认钥匙不见了。

entries.en: Albertus found a parking space just as the concert doors opened.
entries.zh: 音乐会开门入场时，阿尔贝图斯刚好找到了一个停车位。

entries.en: Alberty returned the borrowed books in a waterproof bag.
entries.zh: 艾伯蒂用一个防水袋装着借来的书，还了回去。

entries.en: The printer used albertype for the collection of architectural illustrations.
entries.zh: 印刷师用珂罗版印刷术印制了那套建筑插图。

entries.en: Albin moved the picnic baskets into the shade before joining the game.
entries.zh: 阿尔宾把野餐篮移到树荫下，才加入游戏。

entries.en: The geologists disagreed about whether albitization preceded the formation of the fracture.
entries.zh: 地质学家们对钠长石化是否早于裂隙形成存在分歧。

entries.meaningZh: 肉丸〔西班牙语借词，复数〕
entries.en: She divided the albondigas between two plates and carried them to the table.
entries.zh: 她把肉丸分装在两个盘子里，端上了桌。

entries.en: Albright covered the keyboard before sanding the shelf above it.
entries.zh: 奥尔布赖特先把键盘盖好，才打磨上方的架子。

entries.en: Albritton borrowed my umbrella after discovering a tear in his own.
entries.zh: 奥尔布里顿发现自己的雨伞破了以后，借走了我的。

entries.en: Albu stopped the clock so its ticking would not disturb the recording.
entries.zh: 阿尔布让钟停了下来，免得滴答声干扰录音。

entries.en: We had an hour in Albury before our bus continued its journey.
entries.zh: 巴士继续行驶前，我们在阿尔伯里停留了一个小时。

entries.en: Alby emptied the wardrobe before we tried to move it.
entries.zh: 我们尝试搬衣柜之前，阿尔比把里面的东西清空了。

entries.meaningZh: 要塞司令〔西葡等地称谓〕
entries.en: The alcaide refused to open the fortress gates until dawn.
entries.zh: 要塞司令拒绝在黎明前打开要塞大门。

entries.en: Alcala found the missing button caught in the sofa cushions.
entries.zh: 阿尔卡拉发现丢失的纽扣卡在了沙发坐垫里。

entries.en: Alcaraz handed out forms while I searched for another box of pens.
entries.zh: 阿尔卡拉斯分发表格时，我在寻找另一盒笔。

entries.meaningZh: 要塞司令〔西班牙称谓，alcaide 的异体〕
entries.en: The alcayde sent a messenger to explain why the fortress gates were shut.
entries.zh: 要塞司令派了一名信使，解释要塞大门为何关着。

entries.en: Alce drew a circle around the dates when the hall was available.
entries.zh: 阿尔斯把可以使用大厅的日期圈了出来。

entries.en: Alcedo carried the empty trays back to the kitchen.
entries.zh: 阿尔塞多把空托盘送回了厨房。

entries.en: Alceste waited until the dog was asleep before leaving the room.
entries.zh: 阿尔切斯特等狗睡着后，才离开房间。

entries.en: Alchian asked the framer to keep the original mount behind the photograph.
entries.zh: 阿尔奇安让装裱师保留照片后面原来的衬板。

entries.en: Alcibiade closed the gate after the last visitor had left.
entries.zh: 最后一位访客离开后，阿尔奇比亚德关上了大门。
